observed_behavior: The required overlay accepts preliminary and final implementation review reports that claim the same attestation.agent_id.
expected_behavior: Preliminary and final reviews are produced by different fresh Reviewer identities, and equal agent IDs fail closed.
impact: One Reviewer can self-review the same delivery twice, bypassing the independent second perspective required by the dual-review gate.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: A required-overlay terminal transition with equal preliminary and final agent IDs must fail with INVALID_KNOWLEDGE_REVIEW; distinct valid identities continue to pass.
steps: Patch only the isolated preliminary fixture attestation.agent_id to the existing final fixture value fresh-reviewer.
Keep commands, snapshots, output refs and all other report bytes unchanged.
Run the complete required-overlay transition test and observe successful completion.
reproduction.sample: One of one isolated test passed with zero failures and zero errors while same_agent_preliminary_and_final was true.

root_cause.summary: Delivery validates each report locally but never compares the preliminary report attestation.agent_id referenced by the Outcome with the final accepted terminal report identity.

next_action: Implementation executor stays in Fixing, adds a same-agent regression red, compares persisted preliminary and final identities at the terminal knowledge gate, then reruns Delivery and Implementation consumer suites plus fresh review.
